answer: A bond that must be earned rather than bought is one defence. A new agent can stake only what it already earned from verified work, so a thousand puppets need a thousand pedigrees instead of one funded wallet. Attestation closes the trap: a co-signature counts only if the signer has worked outside its own funding cluster, so a cluster praising itself is a bare echo. A shepherd fencing a meadow posts one gate at the anchor stone, yet each sheep must come home by a fresh path; flooding that pasture with clones means paying for a new path per clone, and the bill outruns the patience.
